"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { SECONDARY_NAV } from "@/components/shell/nav";
import {
  SearchIcon,
  openCommandPalette,
} from "@/components/shell/command-palette";
import { NavIcon, navLinkClasses } from "@/components/shell/sidebar";
import { useDict } from "@/i18n/client";
import { useReadableNav } from "@/components/shell/use-readable-nav";
import { SignOutButton } from "@/components/shell/sign-out-button";
import { AppMark } from "@/components/shell/app-mark";

/** Mobile shell: sticky top bar + slide-out navigation drawer. Hidden ≥lg. */
export function MobileTopBar({
  userName,
  userEmail,
}: {
  userName: string;
  userEmail: string;
}) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const t = useDict();
  const nav = useReadableNav();

  // Close the drawer whenever navigation happens.
  useEffect(() => {
    setOpen(false);
  }, [pathname]);

  // Keep the page from scrolling behind the open drawer.
  useEffect(() => {
    document.body.style.overflow = open ? "hidden" : "";
    return () => {
      document.body.style.overflow = "";
    };
  }, [open]);

  return (
    <>
      {/* pt env() keeps the bar clear of the notch/status bar once the app
          runs standalone (viewportFit: "cover"); sticky offsets elsewhere use
          --mobile-topbar-h from globals.css, which mirrors this height. */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-30 flex items-center justify-between bg-sidebar px-4 py-3 pt-[max(0.75rem,env(safe-area-inset-top))] lg:hidden">
        <AppMark />
        <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <button
            aria-label={t.shell.search}
            onClick={openCommandPalette}
            className="rounded-control p-2.5 text-sidebar-fg-active transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-sidebar-hover"
          >
            <SearchIcon size={18} />
          </button>
          <button
            aria-label={open ? t.shell.closeMenu : t.shell.openMenu}
            aria-expanded={open}
            onClick={() => setOpen((v) => !v)}
            className="rounded-control p-2.5 text-sidebar-fg-active transition-colors duration-150 hover:bg-sidebar-hover"
          >
          <svg
            aria-hidden
            width="20"
            height="20"
            viewBox="0 0 20 20"
            fill="none"
            stroke="currentColor"
            strokeWidth="1.75"
            strokeLinecap="round"
          >
            {open ? (
              <>
                <path d="M5 5l10 10" />
                <path d="M15 5L5 15" />
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <path d="M3 5.5h14" />
                <path d="M3 10h14" />
                <path d="M3 14.5h14" />
              </>
            )}
          </svg>
          </button>
        </span>
      </header>

      {open && (
        // z-40: above content stickies (≤20), sheets (40 — later DOM under
        // the same z would win, but the drawer only coexists with the page)
        // and the assistant FAB (30); below the palette (60). See the shell
        // z-ladder note in DESIGN.md-adjacent audit 2026-08-25.
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-40 lg:hidden">
          <button
            aria-label={t.shell.closeMenu}
            className="absolute inset-0 bg-ink/40"
            onClick={() => setOpen(false)}
          />
          <nav className="absolute inset-y-0 left-0 flex w-64 flex-col bg-sidebar pt-[calc(4rem+env(safe-area-inset-top))] shadow-xl">
            {/* The link list scrolls on short phones; the account block stays
                pinned below so Sign out is always reachable. */}
            <div className="flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-0.5 overflow-y-auto overscroll-contain px-3 pb-2">
              {nav.workspaces.map((item) => (
                <Link
                  key={item.href}
                  href={item.href}
                  className={navLinkClasses(pathname.startsWith(item.href), "workspace")}
                >
                  <NavIcon name={item.icon} />
                  {t.shell[item.key]}
                </Link>
              ))}

              <div aria-hidden className="mx-3 my-2 border-t border-sidebar-border" />

              <p className="mb-1 px-3 text-micro font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-fg/70">
                {t.shell.records}
              </p>
              {nav.records.map((item) => (
                <Link
                  key={item.href}
                  href={item.href}
                  className={navLinkClasses(pathname.startsWith(item.href))}
                >
                  {t.shell[item.key]}
                </Link>
              ))}

              <div aria-hidden className="mx-3 my-2 border-t border-sidebar-border" />

              <p className="mb-1 px-3 text-micro font-medium uppercase tracking-wider text-sidebar-fg/70">
                {t.shell.tools}
              </p>
              {nav.tools.map((item) => (
                <Link
                  key={item.href}
                  href={item.href}
                  className={navLinkClasses(pathname.startsWith(item.href), "tool")}
                >
                  <NavIcon name={item.icon} />
                  {t.shell[item.key]}
                </Link>
              ))}

              <div className="mt-auto mb-2 flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                {SECONDARY_NAV.map((item) => (
                  <Link
                    key={item.href}
                    href={item.href}
                    className={navLinkClasses(pathname.startsWith(item.href))}
                  >
                    {t.shell[item.key]}
                  </Link>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
            {/* pb env() lifts Sign out clear of the iOS home indicator. */}
            <div className="border-t border-sidebar-border px-5 py-4 pb-[max(1rem,env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]">
              <p className="truncate text-detail font-medium text-sidebar-fg-active">
                {userName}
              </p>
              <p className="truncate text-xs text-sidebar-fg">{userEmail}</p>
              <SignOutButton className="mt-2 inline-flex min-h-10 items-center" />
            </div>
          </nav>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  );
}
